title: Dost ka Plan
text:
Dost: Kal subah 6 baje milte hain, ghoomne chalenge.
Main: Pakka?
Dost: Pakka.
Agli subah 6 baje: dono so rahe the,
aur dono khush the. 😴

title: Bill Kaun Dega
text:
Bill aate hi 5 dost ek saath washroom jaate hain.
Jo sabse dheere uthta hai,
wahi us shaam ka hero ban jaata hai. 🧾

title: 10 Minute Me Aaya
text:
Dost ka "10 minute" aur
train ka "5 minute late"
ek hi unit me naapte hain.
Dono ka koi bharosa nahi. 🚉

title: Dost ki Advice
text:
Dost ki salaah hamesha free hoti hai,
aur usi keemat ki hoti hai.
Phir bhi hum wahi maante hain. 🤷

title: Plan Cancel
text:
Group me trip ka plan bana.
47 messages.
3 Google Docs.
1 budget sheet.
Result: sab apne-apne ghar. 🗺️

title: Sacha Dost
text:
Sacha dost wo hai
jo aapki galti pe haste hue kahe:
"Maine pehle hi bola tha"
aur phir bhi aapke saath khada rahe. 🤝

title: Dost ki Photography
text:
Ladkiyon ke dost 60 photo kheenchte hain.
Ladkon ke dost ek photo kheenchte hain —
wo bhi aadhi, blur, aur usme bhi ungli. 📷

title: Udhaar ka Paisa
text:
Dost se 500 rupaye udhaar liye.
Wo bhool gaya.
Main bhi bhool gaya.
Dosti aise hi chalti hai — accounts me nahi, dil me. 💵

title: Dost ke Ghar
text:
Dost ki mummy ka khana hamesha tasty lagta hai.
Aur apni mummy ka khana dost ko.
Duniya ka sabse bada exchange program. 🍽️

title: Exam Se Pehle
text:
Dost: Maine kuch nahi padha, tension mat le.
Exam hall me: wo 3 supplementary copies le raha tha.
Dosti me bhi trust issues aa gaye. 📝

title: Purane Dost
text:
Purane dost se 4 saal baad mile.
2 minute me lagta hai
jaise kal hi mile the.
Aur 2 ghante me wahi purane kisse phir se. ❤️

title: Dosti ki Bhasha
text:
Dosti ki ek ajeeb baat hai:
jitna zyada mazaak udate hain,
utna zyada sambhalte hain.
Baahar walon ko ye samajh nahi aata. 🙃

title: Dost ka Reply
text:
Main: Bhai emergency hai.
Dost: 2 min
3 ghante baad.
Dost: Haan bol.
Emergency khud hi solve ho chuki thi. ⏳

title: Dost ki Shaadi
text:
Dost ki shaadi me
sabse zyada kaam hum karte hain,
sabse kam photo me aate hain,
aur sabse zyada emotional bhi hum hi hote hain. 💐

title: Ek Dost Aisa Bhi
text:
Har group me ek dost hota hai
jo kehta hai "mujhe bhookh nahi hai"
aur phir sabki plate se khaata hai. 🍟

title: Dosti ka Insurance
text:
Dosti duniya ki ekmatra policy hai
jisme premium chai ka hota hai
aur coverage poori zindagi ka. ☕
